text:
<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
I need both the weather in Berlin and a calculation of 9 times 8.
</user>
<assistant>
I will get the weather for Berlin and calculate 9 times 8.
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_weather","arguments":{"location":"Berlin"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_weather","result":"Berlin: 9°C, cloudy, light wind."}
</tool_result>
<tool_call>
{"name":"calculator","arguments":{"expression":"9 * 8"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calculator","result":"72"}
</tool_result>
Berlin is currently 9°C and cloudy. 9 multiplied by 8 equals 72.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Create a note titled 'Groceries' containing 'eggs, bread, butter'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will create the groceries note.
<tool_call>
{"name":"notes_create","arguments":{"title":"Groceries","content":"eggs, bread, butter"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"notes_create","result":"Note created successfully with id note_5567."}
</tool_result>
The note 'Groceries' has been created with the items eggs, bread, and butter.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Do I have anything on the calendar for tomorrow? Assume today is 2026-11-06.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search the calendar for 2026-11-07.
<tool_call>
{"name":"calendar_search","arguments":{"date":"2026-11-07"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calendar_search","result":"Event found: Dentist appointment at 09:30."}
</tool_result>
Tomorrow (2026-11-07) you have a dentist appointment at 09:30.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Just say the word 'ready' without tools.
</user>
<assistant>
Ready.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Search notes for 'vacation plans'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search your notes for vacation plans.
<tool_call>
{"name":"notes_search","arguments":{"query":"vacation plans"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"notes_search","result":"Error: No matching notes found."}
</tool_result>
No notes about vacation plans were found.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
What is 25 percent of 200?
</user>
<assistant>
I will calculate 25 percent of 200.
<tool_call>
{"name":"calculator","arguments":{"expression":"0.25 * 200"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calculator","result":"50"}
</tool_result>
25 percent of 200 is 50.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Get the current time in UTC.
</user>
<assistant>
I will retrieve the time in the UTC timezone.
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_time","arguments":{"timezone":"UTC"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_time","result":"Current time in UTC: 16:54."}
</tool_result>
The current time in UTC is 16:54.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Look up the boiling point of water.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search for the boiling point of water.
<tool_call>
{"name":"web_search","arguments":{"query":"boiling point of water"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"web_search","result":"At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit)."}
</tool_result>
At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100°C (212°F).
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Check weather in London and time in London.
</user>
<assistant>
I will obtain both the weather and the local time for London.
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_weather","arguments":{"location":"London"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_weather","result":"London: 11°C, drizzle, humidity 80%."}
</tool_result>
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_time","arguments":{"timezone":"Europe/London"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_time","result":"Current time in Europe/London: 16:54."}
</tool_result>
London is currently 11°C with drizzle. The local time is 16:54.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
I want to know something but I am not sure what tool to use.
</user>
<assistant>
Please describe what you would like to know or accomplish, and I will choose the appropriate approach.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Is a dog a mammal, reptile, or bird?
</user>
<assistant>
A dog is a mammal.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Classify these words as positive or negative: joyful, sad, excited, angry.
</user>
<assistant>
Joyful: positive. Sad: negative. Excited: positive. Angry: negative.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Is rain a form of precipitation? Yes or no.
</user>
<assistant>
Yes.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Categorise the following as indoor or outdoor activity: swimming in a lake, reading a book, hiking, watching a movie at home.
</user>
<assistant>
Swimming in a lake: outdoor. Reading a book: indoor. Hiking: outdoor. Watching a movie at home: indoor.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Rewrite this sentence to be more polite: 'Give me the report now.'
</user>
<assistant>
Could you please send me the report when you have a moment?
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Make this sentence shorter: 'Due to the fact that it was raining heavily, the outdoor event had to be cancelled.'
</user>
<assistant>
Because of heavy rain, the outdoor event was cancelled.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Rewrite in the past tense: 'She walks to the store every morning.'
</user>
<assistant>
She walked to the store every morning.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Turn this into a question: 'The meeting starts at 3 PM.'
</user>
<assistant>
Does the meeting start at 3 PM?
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Rewrite to remove the passive voice: 'The cake was baked by my sister.'
</user>
<assistant>
My sister baked the cake.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
First say hello, then name a primary color, and finally wish me a good day.
</user>
<assistant>
Hello. Blue. Have a good day.
</assistant>
